quality.fvd_protocol: 256 matched16-frame clips:3 true context+13 generated,64->224 bilinear; this is not inheritedRGB16FVD2048
quality.angle: wrapped absolute atan2(sin,cos) minus simulator angle,in degrees
quality.scope: Complete quality metrics; independent protocol directory; final32-case pass/fail review still required.

additional_quality.scope: Mean/copy/sample perceptual comparisons here all use the same saved uint8 pixels. Each sampled-trajectory FVD uses256 real and256 fake clips; four draws reported separately,not pooled as1024 independent real cases. Copy and sample perceptual metrics use the saveduint8bank.

counterfactual.scope: Single-seed matched-reset simulator counterfactuals; deterministic mean-state dynamics; reset cannot recover unsaved block velocity
